notes: Generated routing and basic-output starter. Curate realistic prompts and example-backed task scenarios before treating it as behavior evidence.

should_trigger.prompt: Please create leadership-ready enablement impact narratives and, only when the evidence supports it, financial ROI analysis with explicit assumptions and risks.
I need an enablement impact story, executive summary, board-ready narrative, initiative outcome update, or defensible ROI calculation tied to performance and strategic priorities.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable enablement impact story and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please define revenue enablement KPI trees and measurement plans that connect enablement work to business outcomes.
Please create role-based readiness certifications with evidence requirements, defensible pass/fail standards, behaviorally anchored scoring, and assessor calibration.
Please synthesize multi-source field feedback into traceable themes, segment differences, evidence limits, and owner-ready actions for enablement, product marketing, sales leadership, or product.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-impact-story-core-output
output_structure_checks.description: Produces Executive summary narrative; Claim mode and why the evidence supports it.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-impact-story-decision-discipline
output_structure_checks.description: Makes the requested decision or next action explicit while separating verified evidence, provisional assumptions, conflicts, and decision-critical unknowns.
